fixed_literal_decoder_contract:
Whole JSON {'v': scalar}, JSON scalar, or one bare unquoted atom only.

    Strings preserve exact case/spelling. JSON numeric lexical spelling is kept
    exactly:48.00 !=48.0. No substring extraction, prose/fences, punctuation

interpretation: The observed first-record collapse is task-specific. After adaptation, many unique queried-entity/field answers and joined endpoint codes are copied correctly from non-first records; update rows with several revisions for the same entity/field fail when the greatest revision is not first.

Identifier selection is an especially strong finite control: B/C/D answer all64 rows correctly, including all36 cases whose queried shipment record is second, across both template forms and both evidence positions. This falsifies a universal first-record output rule on these saved outputs.

C/D answer zero of26 distant update rows whose greatest-revision record is not first, while supplying first-record values on every distant update row. The generic entity-binding controls can work at distant positions, so the saved pattern does not justify a universal loss of attention or distant evidence access.
Join success on non-first final-code records shows some multi-hop selection outputs are correct. It is not proof of an exclusive latent algorithm or an exclusive recurrent route.

Counterfactual response requires changing to the new correct literal, not merely producing different text. Raw formatting and literal correctness remain separate; dependent position/counterfactual variants share worlds.

This is localization/falsification within the already completed old matched matrix. No new source quality gain, broad retention, confirmation or cross-corpus causal claim follows. Other27 sites retain full attention.

The actionable hypothesis concerns selecting the greatest revision among multiple same-entity/field candidates. A future separately permitted order-only control should preserve successful unique-entity selection and correct field/endpoint binding while moving the winning revision record among slots; include revision-versus-payload conflict cases. No native retry or corpus/run proposal is created here.
limitations: Only saved old synthetic DEV outputs; one source/site/seed and16 dependent worlds per family.
